card.name: The word artificial in medical text
card.fires_on: The word "artificial" (or its start, "Art" + "ificial"), mainly in drug-label text. It appears before respiration, ventilation, tears, flavoring or "artificially".

modes.label: Artificial respiration
modes.description: "Artificial" before respiration or ventilation in overdose or resuscitation advice.
modes.example: Respiratory depression may be counteracted by<< artificial>> respiration and mechanical respirators.

modes.label: Other artificial items
modes.description: "Artificial" before tears, syrup, or as "Artificially" in lab tables.
modes.example: tinidazole tablets may be crushed in<< artificial>> cherry syrup to be taken with food.

card.writes: It pushes toward the word intelligence, as in "artificial intelligence", after "artificial".
card.plain: It fires on the word "artificial" and helps the model guess what follows, such as "intelligence".
